title: Typhoon Rosal keeps strength; 2 areas under Signal No. 2

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two areas remained under Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal (TCWS) No. 2 as Typhoon Rosal maintained its strength while moving over the sea east of Batanes, the state weather bureau reported on Friday. In its 5 a.m. weather bulletin, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Rosal had a sustained winds of 155 kilometers per hour (kph) and gusts of up to 190 kph. Batanes and the northeastern portion of the Babuyan Islands, such as Babuyan Island, Panuitan Island, Calayan Island, and Camiguin Island remained under TCWS No. 2.
